Improving Task Instructions for Data Annotators: How Clear Rules and Higher Pay Increase Performance in Data Annotation in the AI Economy (2312.14565v2) · paper method: Besides image-label accuracy, the study measures perceived instruction helpfulness and perceived task difficulty separately.
